SIT-041.text:
I'm sorry, I don't know the date of the next village meeting because I haven't been informed yet. Kindly check with the chairman, who should be able to provide the correct information.

Simanyi lunaku lutuufu lukiiko lwakyaalo lwelunabeerayo era teri yangambye. Ndowooza wandibuziza Chairman alina ebisingawo ku nsonga eyo

SIT-042.text: Bwenategeera delivare yo lwenatuuka njakutegeeza, webale nnyo

SIT-043.text:
Ekiwandiiko 

Olunaku olukiiko lwe lunatuula lujja kutegezeebwa jebujja 

mwebale nnyo

SIT-044.text: Sekakasa lunaku lutuufu kigezo lwekinabeerayo kubanga silujukira. Osobola okubuuza omusomesa akutegeeze olunaku olutuufu olwekigezo.

SIT-045.text: Jjajja, ekyuma ekiteeka amasannyalaze mu ssimu kiyitibwa charger. Kikozesebwa okujjuza amasannyalaze mu ssimu ng'okigasse ku masannyalaze. Omuliro ku ssimu bwegugwaako, okozesa charger okuguzzaamu, esobole okuddamu okukola.

SIT-046.text: Naaba mu ngalo nga tonnaba kulya. Kino kikuyamba okuggyawo obuwuka obuyinza okukuleetera endwadde.

SIT-047.text:
Okusindika ssente ku Mobile Money, kola bino:
1. Genda mu app ya Mobile Money ku ssimu yo oba nyiga *185#.
2. Londa ekifo ekiwandiikiddwa nti **Send Money**.
3. Yingiza ennamba y'essimu y'omuntu gw'ogenda okusindikira ssente.
4. Wandiika omuwendo gwa ssente z'oyagala okusindika.
5. Erinnya ly'omuntu gw'owereza sente lijja kujja ku screen yo.
6. Kebera bulungi erinnya ly'omuntu n'omuwendo gw'osindika.
7. Yingiza PIN yo okukakasa okusindika ssente.
8. Linda obubaka mu messegi obukakasa nti ssente zisindikiddwa bulungi.

SIT-048.text: Leero lwokya nnyo. Kyokka enkuba eyinza okutonnya akawungeezi.

SIT-049.text: Twetaaga okunywa amazzi amayonjo okusobola okukuuma obulamu bwaffe n’okwewala endwadde.

SIT-050.text:
1. Londa ettaka eggimu era eririna amazzi agayitamu obulungi.
2. Simba ensigo z'ebijanjaro mu bifo ebirina ebbanga erimala.
3. Fuba okulima n'okuyoola omuddo buli kiseera guve mu nimiro y'ebijanjaro byo

SIT-051.text:
Webale nnyo, Ssebo/Nnyabo, olw'okutuyigiriza n'okutuyamba okufuna okumanya n'amagezi.
Tusiima nnyo obukozi bwo, obugumiikiriza n'okutufaako.

SIT-052.note:
Mutabani can mean son
muwala can mean daughter, 

these two words in this context are relating to when a person that is telling the child they are in the age of birthing them or when they are older

SIT-055.text: Omuwendo nga munene nnyo, nsaba ompe ku muwendo ogwa wansi ko

SIT-056.text: Sukali aweddewo mu dduuka leero, naye tujja kufuna enkya

SIT-057.text: Njagala kugula kilo bbiri ez'omuceere ne kilo emu eya sukali.

SIT-058.text: Omuwendo ogwa wamu silinji omutwaalo gumu, n'enkumi bbiri

SIT-059.text: Nsaba ompoleyo enkumi ttaano njakuzizza ku lwokutaano

SIT-060.text: Oba ani ono ankubide essimu? nsaba ombulire amanya go

SIT-061.text: Gw'okubide essimu taliiwo, ddamu ogezeeko okuba eddako

SIT-063.text: Nsaba omperezeeko ku kifaananyi kyewankubye eggulo

SIT-064.text: Musawo, omwaana wange abade alina omusujja okumala enaku bbiri

SIT-065.text: nkusabira Katonda akuwonye obulwadde obukuluma amangu ddala

SIT-066.text: Jjajja, jjukira okumira eddagala lyo ng’omaze okulya.

SIT-067.text:
Musomesa oli otya eyo, nkutegeeza nti omwana wange tajja kusobola kujja ku ssomero olwaleero olw'ensonga tulinayo emikolo j'ekika. Nkusaba omusonyiwe olw'obutabaawo.
Webale nnyo.

SIT-068.text: Abayizi enkya muleete ebitabo byamwe ne bayilo olunaku lwenkya

SIT-069.text: Musomesa nsaba oddemu onyinyonyole olusoma lwa leero, sabitegedde.

SIT-070.text: Mwaniriziddwa nnyo mu nnyumba ya Katonda. Tuli basanyufu okubaaniriza mu kusaba kwaffe leero. Katonda abawe omukisa era abasembeze mu kusinza wamu naffe.

SIT-071.text: Tubategeeza nti ekibiina ky'abayimbi (kwaaya) kijja kuyimba ku mbaga ku Lwomukaaga.

SIT-072.text: Ndi wamu naawe era nkukwatirwaako ekisa mu kiseera kino eky'ennaku, olw'okufiirwa jjajjaawo. Katonda akuwe amaanyi n'obugumu okugumira ekikangabwa kino.

SIT-073.text: Mbayozayoza ne mutabani wo olw'okuyita ebigezo, kino kiraga obukozi n'okubeera omugezi. Mbasanyukideko

SIT-074.text: Genda butereevu, ojakusanga  omuti omunene okyaame ku kkono. Akatale kali ku mukono gwo ogwa ddyo.

SIT-075.text: Ssebo owa boda bwotuuka mu kkoona eridako nga oyimirira

SIT-076.text: NZe mbuuza eddwaaliro eriri okumpi wano liri ludda wa?

SIT-078.text: Komawo ewaka nga obudde tebunaba kukwaata nzikiza

SIT-079.text: Bakadde baffe, tubayita mujje tulye ku mmere

SIT-081.text: Abakozi mwenna, mutandike okulima omuddo mu lusuku obudde nga bukyaali, era mumalirize nga enjuba tennaba kwokya nnyo.

SIT-082.text: Matooke gange gatuse okutundibwa. Nsaba ojje ogalabe.

SIT-083.text: Mukama wange, nsaba onzikirize okuva ku mulimu nga bukyaali enkya olw'ensonga nina ensonga za waka. Nja kukola enteekateeka okusobola okumaliriza emirimu gyange egyetaagisa. Webale nnyo olw'okutegeera.

SIT-085.text: Mubuwombeefu obunji nsaba kunsonyiwa olwobutasobola kubeerawo, Nina obuvunanyizibwa obukulu ddala bwenzija okubeerako.

SIT-086.text: NSaba onsonyiwe bambi olwokwelabira olunaku lw'amazalibwa go

SIT-087.text: Njakukyalirako olw'okutaano olujja kusaawa kkumi eza kawungeezi

SIT-088.text: Akabaga kaali ka Lwamukaaga oluwedde ssaawa emu eyakawungeezi

SIT-089.text: Nkusaba ojje okwoosa enkya saawa kkumi neemu ezokumakya

SIT-090.text: Edduuka liggulawo ssaawa kkumi nabbiri ezokumakya neligalawo ssaawa ssattu ezekiro buli lunaku

SIT-092.text: Ebula essaawa ssatu okutuuka ku mmere yakawungeezi

SIT-093.text: Essomero litandika ssaawa emu ey'okumakya okutuuka ssaawa mwenda ez'emisana

SIT-096.text: Onansonyiwa obutajja eggulo, sasobode kubanga enkuba yattonye

SIT-099.text: Njagade okulabula nti oluguudo olugenda mu kyalo lujjudde amazzi oluvannyuma lw'enkuba okutonnya, lwajjude amataba

SIT-100.text: Tubategeeza nti olugendo olwabadde lutegekeddwa enkya lusaziddwamu olw'enkuba. Olunaku olulala tujja kululangirira tubategeeze. Mwebale nnyo.
